title: Did the Problem Actually Get Harder? Testing LLMs on Paired P and NP-Complete Problems Hardened by Adversarial Multi-Agent Rewriting
abstract: arXiv:2610.30103v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many NP-complete (NPC) problems have a polynomial-time (P) twin that differs in a single structural detail, such as 3- versus 2-colouring a graph. A model that reasons rather than recalls should notice which side of this boundary a problem falls on, yet existing benchmarks either fix the wording of each task or ignore its complexity class, so they cannot separate the two. We introduce P2NPCBench, a benchmark of 12 problem families in which every NPC problem is paired with a P twin posed over the same surface. To remove the textbook cues that enable recall, we build it with AgentGAN, an adversarial multi-agent framework in which a generator rewrites each statement until a panel of frozen code models fails, while an executable validity gate keeps every rewrite answer- and class-preserving. translated_title: 问题真的变难了吗？通过对抗性多智能体重写加固的P与NP完全配对问题测试大语言模型
translated_abstract: 许多NP完全（NPC）问题都存在一个多项式时间（P）的“孪生”问题，两者仅在单个结构细节上有所不同，例如对图进行3着色与2着色。一个真正进行推理而非依赖记忆的模型，应该能够辨别问题处于这一边界的哪一侧，然而现有的基准测试要么固定了每个任务的措辞，要么忽略了其复杂度类，因此无法将推理与记忆区分开来。我们提出了P2NPCBench，这是一个包含12个问题族的基准，其中每个NPC问题都与一个在同一表面形式下提出的P孪生问题配对。为了消除使模型能够进行记忆的教科书式线索，我们使用AgentGAN构建了该基准——这是一个对抗性多智能体框架，其中生成器不断重写每个题目描述，直到一组冻结的代码模型无法解答为止，同时由一个可执行的有效性门控确保每次重写都保持答案与复杂度类不变。最终产生了2,114个经过加固的题目，并配有经人工验证的参考人类求解器。通过评估12个专有和开源模型，我们发现每个（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出P2NPCBench基准，将NP完全问题与仅有一个结构细节之差的P类孪生问题配对，并利用对抗性多智能体重写框架消除教科书式记忆线索，以检验大语言模型是真正具备区分问题复杂度类的推理能力还是仅仅依赖记忆。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces P2NPCBench, a benchmark pairing NP-complete problems with P twins differing in a single structural detail, and uses an adversarial multi-agent rewriting framework (AgentGAN) to strip away textbook recall cues, thereby testing whether LLMs genuinely reason about complexity classes or merely memorize familiar problem formulations.
